route_narrowing.user_direction: Map visual affordance literature from dataset-grounded labels toward open-vocabulary grounding, part geometry, and foundation-model priors.

baseline_paper_field_scope.primary_problem: Localize object regions or parts that support a requested action, especially when action/object labels, viewpoints, or categories differ from the training setting.
baseline_paper_field_scope.input_output: Inputs are RGB images, object-centric crops, language/action prompts, support examples, 3D point clouds, or frozen visual foundation model activations. Outputs are affordance masks, keypoints, part/region labels, point-wise affordance scores, or diagnostic maps.
baseline_paper_field_scope.evaluation_setting: Affordance localization and segmentation are measured with pixel, part, or point-level overlap and ranking metrics, plus cross-category, one-shot, zero-shot, and prompt-conditioned transfer settings where available.
baseline_paper_field_scope.survey_boundary: Paper-only map for visual affordance grounding, open-text affordance reasoning, 3D/spatial affordance grounding, and foundation-model evidence used to explain or transfer affordance predictions.
exclusion_rules: Exclude pure grasp-planning or robot-control papers unless visual affordance grounding is an explicit evaluated output.
Exclude general VLM/VFM papers unless they are used as dense correspondence, perception prior, or affordance evidence for this field.
Exclude dataset-only listings without an accompanying paper.
Do not treat baseline internal components, losses, or fusion stages as routes.

routes.label: RGB Object-Part Grounding
routes.description: Papers that predict affordance regions, parts, keypoints, or masks from RGB object/scene images with dataset-defined affordance labels.

routes.label: Text-Conditioned Affordance Grounding
routes.description: Papers that use action names, instructions, large language models, or support examples to move beyond a closed affordance label set.

routes.label: 3D Spatial Affordance Grounding
routes.description: Papers that ground affordances on point clouds, 3D object parts, or geometry-aware object representations.

routes.label: VFM Affordance Auditing
routes.description: Papers that test whether frozen visual foundation models carry part, geometry, or action-relevant cues that can support affordance grounding.

papers.title: Visual Affordance and Function Understanding: A Survey
papers.source_evidence: Survey paper frames visual affordance and function understanding across object, scene, and action settings, making it a calibration node for field boundaries.
papers.summary: Broad survey that names affordance detection, object function, and interaction understanding as connected visual recognition problems.
papers.field_position: Field-boundary survey before open-text and VFM-era affordance grounding became central.
papers.method_setting: Literature survey over visual affordance and function understanding.

papers.title: Detecting Object Affordances with Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.source_evidence: Paper applies CNNs to object affordance detection and evaluates on RGB-D object affordance data, anchoring early deep visual affordance detection.
papers.summary: Early CNN approach to object affordance detection from visual input, before large-scale affordance grounding benchmarks.
papers.field_position: Closed-set visual affordance detection from object images.

papers.title: AffordanceNet: An End-to-End Deep Learning Approach for Object Affordance Detection
papers.source_evidence: Introduces AffordanceNet for simultaneous object detection and affordance segmentation, a standard anchor for part-level visual affordance masks.
papers.summary: Turns affordance prediction into object detection plus pixel-level affordance mask estimation.

papers.title: One-Shot Object Affordance Detection in the Wild
papers.source_evidence: Paper introduces one-shot object affordance detection in the wild and PADv2, shifting evaluation toward support-example transfer.
papers.summary: Extends affordance detection from closed labels toward support-image transfer in natural scenes.
papers.field_position: Bridge between supervised object affordance segmentation and open/unseen affordance settings.
papers.method_setting: One-shot affordance detection with support examples.

papers.title: Learning Affordance Grounding from Exocentric Images
papers.source_evidence: Introduces AGD20K and affordance grounding from exocentric images, making the human-object interaction signal central to dataset-grounded visual affordance localization.
papers.summary: Defines a large exocentric affordance grounding dataset and task where interaction examples supervise object-region predictions.
papers.field_position: Large-scale 2D affordance grounding benchmark centered on exocentric interaction evidence.

papers.title: LOCATE: Localize and Transfer Object Parts for Weakly Supervised Affordance Grounding
papers.source_evidence: Paper frames weakly supervised affordance grounding as localizing and transferring object parts, aligning with the project question about part-level priors.
papers.summary: Uses part localization and transfer to reduce direct pixel-level affordance supervision.
papers.field_position: 2D affordance grounding with part-level transfer pressure.
papers.method_setting: Weakly supervised part localization and transfer.

papers.title: One-Shot Open Affordance Learning with Foundation Models
papers.source_evidence: Paper studies one-shot open affordance learning with foundation models, directly linking support examples, open action labels, and visual affordance maps.
papers.summary: Moves affordance learning toward open labels and limited examples by using foundation-model knowledge.
papers.field_position: Open affordance transfer from support examples and foundation-model priors.

papers.title: AffordanceLLM: Grounding Affordance from Vision Language Models
papers.source_evidence: Paper grounds affordance using vision-language models, representing the language-knowledge branch of open affordance reasoning.
papers.summary: Uses VLM/LLM knowledge to connect textual affordance concepts with visual regions.
papers.field_position: Language-guided affordance grounding beyond fixed dataset labels.

papers.title: INTRA: Interaction Relationship-aware Weakly Supervised Affordance Grounding
papers.source_evidence: Paper emphasizes interaction relationship-aware weak supervision for affordance grounding, linking human-object interaction cues to localization.
papers.summary: Uses interaction relationships to guide weakly supervised affordance grounding.
papers.field_position: Interaction-aware bridge between exocentric grounding and open instruction settings.
papers.method_setting: Weakly supervised affordance grounding with interaction relations.

papers.title: 3D AffordanceNet: A Benchmark for Visual Object Affordance Understanding
papers.source_evidence: Introduces a 3D object affordance benchmark with point-wise labels, shifting affordance grounding from image masks to spatial object parts.
papers.summary: Defines point-cloud affordance prediction as a benchmarked visual understanding task.
papers.field_position: 3D spatial affordance benchmark and dataset anchor.

papers.title: Grounding 3D Object Affordance from 2D Interactions in Images
papers.source_evidence: Paper grounds 3D object affordance from 2D interactions in images and introduces IAGNet, connecting exocentric interaction evidence with 3D affordance labels.
papers.summary: Transfers interaction evidence from 2D images into 3D affordance grounding.
papers.field_position: Cross-setting bridge between exocentric 2D interactions and 3D point-level affordance.

papers.title: GREAT: Geometry-Intention Collaborative Inference for Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Affordance Grounding
papers.source_evidence: Paper explicitly targets open-vocabulary 3D object affordance grounding with geometry-intention inference, joining text-conditioned and 3D affordance branches.

papers.field_position: Hybrid of open-text affordance grounding and 3D spatial affordance.

papers.title: Part-Aware Open-Vocabulary 3D Affordance Grounding via Prototypical Semantic and Geometric Alignment
papers.source_evidence: Paper targets language-driven, part-aware open-vocabulary 3D affordance grounding with prototypical semantic and geometric alignment, making it a recent hybrid spatial/open branch.

papers.title: Deep ViT Features as Dense Visual Descriptors
papers.source_evidence: Shows deep ViT activations can serve as dense visual descriptors for semantic correspondence, a key prior for part-level affordance transfer.

papers.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision

major_trends.name: From closed labels to transfer pressure
major_trends.summary: The line moves from supervised affordance masks toward one-shot, weakly supervised, and open-text settings.

major_trends.name: Part and geometry become central evidence
major_trends.summary: Part localization and 3D point-level grounding turn affordance from label recognition into spatial/actionable region prediction.

major_trends.name: Human-object interaction cues bridge image and action
major_trends.summary: Exocentric and interaction-aware papers use observed interactions to identify the object regions that afford actions.

major_trends.name: Frozen visual models become objects of study
major_trends.summary: Dense correspondence and self-supervised VFMs are no longer only backbones; papers test whether they already encode useful part and geometry cues.

notable_forks.name: Dataset-grounded masks vs open-text affordance grounding
notable_forks.summary: The fork changes the core failure mode from mask quality under known labels to semantic-action transfer under new labels.

notable_forks.name: 2D interaction evidence vs 3D spatial grounding
notable_forks.summary: IAGNet and later 3D open-text papers try to bridge interaction cues and spatial object structure.

notable_forks.name: Language knowledge vs visual prior evidence
notable_forks.summary: AffordanceLLM and the 2026 baseline address similar open affordance questions but stress different evidence sources.

positioning_note: The baseline paper, Probing and Bridging Geometry-Interaction Cues for Affordance Reasoning in Vision Foundation Models, sits as a convergence node rather than a starting point. Earlier work defines object-part affordance masks, exocentric grounding benchmarks, one-shot/open transfer, 3D spatial affordance labels, and dense VFM priors. The baseline asks whether modern visual foundation models already carry the geometry and interaction cues needed for affordance reasoning, then bridges those cues for the task. It should be read as a field-scope detector for affordance grounding plus VFM evidence, not as a prompt to make DINO/Flux/loss components the lineage routes.
